summary:
Offline storage verified: ZERO network calls to /api observed during full UI flow (home -> free art -> draw -> save attempt -> gallery -> color wheel). Home bundled images render correctly. However BOTH previously-failing bugs are STILL REPRODUCIBLE and block the end-to-end save->gallery flow:
  (1) SaveSheet save-confirm-btn is still laid out at document y=1620px while viewport height is 844px — the KeyboardAvoidingView (react-native-keyboard-controller) with enabled={Platform.OS !== 'web'} still takes flex:1 and renders as an 844px-tall sibling above the sheet, so the sheet is positioned at y=1444 and the Save button at y=1620. Visually the sheet appears via Modal's slide animation but DOM click coordinates land outside the viewport; the input accepts text but tapping save-confirm-btn (with or without force=True) does NOT fire onPress, so no toast appears and nothing is saved.
  (2) ColorWheelSheet single Pressable (testID 'color-wheel') does not update color-wheel-hex when tapped on web. react-native-web's Pressable onPress nativeEvent exposes pageX/pageY (relative to page), not locationX/locationY (relative to element). e.nativeEvent.locationX is undefined on web so colorAt(undefined, undefined) returns null and setPicked is never called. Hex stays at the initial value regardless of where you tap on the wheel. Grey swatches below the wheel still work; apply-btn closes the sheet without the responder-terminate error from last iteration.
As a result, saved artwork persistence, home-recent, gallery items, reopen-and-update, and delete flows could NOT be exercised through the UI this iteration. No /api calls were made at any point — offline storage integration itself is wired correctly (storage.setItem is never reached because save never fires).

ui_bugs.issue: save-confirm-btn still outside viewport. Measured getBoundingClientRect at {x:24,y:1620,w:342,h:52} on 390x844 viewport. Parent KeyboardAvoidingView is 844px tall even with enabled={Platform.OS !== 'web'} (react-native-keyboard-controller still participates in layout). onPress never fires via Playwright click. autoFocus is correctly disabled on web (good) but KAV wrapper is still the layout culprit. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SaveSheet.tsx:26 (KeyboardAvoidingView style={{flex:1}}). Suggested fix: on web, drop the KAV entirely and render <Pressable backdrop/> + <View sheet/> as absolute-positioned siblings, or set KAV style to {flex: Platform.OS === 'web' ? 0 : 1} and let the sheet position itself at bottom via style={position:'absolute',bottom:0}.

Tapping anywhere on the SVG wheel does NOT change color-wheel-hex on web. The single <Pressable testID='color-wheel'> uses e.nativeEvent.locationX/locationY which are undefined under react-native-web (web only exposes pageX/pageY on the Pressable nativeEvent). colorAt(undefined, undefined) returns null so setPicked is never invoked. Grey swatches work. Fix: use onPressIn or capture the raw DOM event via onStartShouldSetResponder with pageX/pageY and subtract the wheel element's bounding rect, or wrap in a web-only <View onClick={e => colorAt(e.nativeEvent.offsetX, e.nativeEvent.offsetY)}/> via Platform.select. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ColorWheelSheet.tsx:88-94

integration_issues.flow: canvas-save -> canvas-toast -> home-recent -> gallery-item -> reopen -> update (no duplicate) -> gallery-delete-confirm-btn -> gallery-empty
integration_issues.issue: Entire chain is blocked at step 1 because save-confirm-btn is unclickable. Could not verify persistence after reload, update-vs-create logic, or delete flow via UI. No /api calls were made (offline storage wiring confirmed from code review — api.ts uses storage.getItem/setItem only).

issues: On web the KeyboardAvoidingView wrapper creates an 844px tall layout container that pushes the slide-up sheet to y>viewport in the DOM. Even though the Modal's visual slide animation makes it look positioned at bottom, DOM-level click/tap coordinates fail. Use Platform.OS !== 'web' to conditionally skip the wrapper entirely.

react_native_issues.issue: KeyboardAvoidingView with enabled=false still consumes flex:1 of its parent, shifting absolute child layout. On web, prefer skipping the component rather than disabling it. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SaveSheet.tsx:26

react-native-web Pressable onPress nativeEvent does not expose locationX/locationY (only pageX/pageY). Code reading nativeEvent.locationX silently fails on web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ColorWheelSheet.tsx:91

action_items: SaveSheet: on web, skip KeyboardAvoidingView entirely (render just backdrop + sheet). Alternatively keep KAV but set style={Platform.OS === 'web' ? undefined : {flex:1}} and position the sheet via absolute bottom:0. Verify save-confirm-btn getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= window.innerHeight.

ColorWheelSheet: replace e.nativeEvent.locationX/locationY with web-safe coordinates — e.g. use onPressIn and compute (pageX - wrapperPageX) via onLayout, OR Platform.select a plain <div onClick={e => colorAt(e.nativeEvent.offsetX, e.nativeEvent.offsetY)}/>, OR wrap <Svg> in View onStartShouldSetResponder which reliably provides locationX on web.

After both fixes, re-run end-to-end: draw -> save -> toast 'Saved to gallery' -> home-recent-{id} present -> page.reload() -> persists -> gallery-item-{id} -> tap -> strokes reload -> edit + save -> same id (no duplicate) -> gallery-delete-{id} -> confirm -> gallery-empty.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts: double JSON encoding path — storage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list)) wraps in another JSON.stringify under the hood (storage auto-serializes). Reading back then JSON.parse(raw ?? '[]') round-trips correctly but is wasteful and brittle. Simpler: cast list as unknown as string in both read/write or add an array-aware helper. Not blocking.
SaveSheet: KeyboardAvoidingView still a layout participant even when enabled=false — not a safe web fallback.

ColorWheelSheet: using nativeEvent.locationX is a known react-native-web gap on Pressable. Use onStartShouldSetResponder / onResponderRelease on a plain View for reliable locationX across platforms, or switch to pageX minus layout origin.

rca_of_issue:
SaveSheet RCA: react-native-keyboard-controller's KeyboardAvoidingView renders a wrapper div with display:flex, flex:1 regardless of its enabled prop (enabled only governs keyboard listeners, not layout). Inside the Modal, that wrapper reserves 844px, so <Pressable backdrop flex:1/> + <View sheet/> stack as a column whose combined height exceeds the viewport, placing the sheet at y=1444 in document coordinates. Modal's slide animation visually transforms the whole stack upward, so the user sees the sheet at bottom, but Playwright (and real tap handlers at DOM coords) resolve clicks to the pre-transform position and miss the target. Mitigation: on web, bypass KAV entirely (fragments or conditional render) and let the sheet position itself.
ColorWheelSheet RCA: react-native-web's Pressable onPress constructs a synthetic nativeEvent exposing pageX/pageY from the pointer event, but does NOT populate locationX/locationY (those are a React Native responder-system concept not implemented on Pressable's onPress for web). Code at ColorWheelSheet.tsx:91 reads e.nativeEvent.locationX/locationY, both undefined on web, so colorAt(NaN,NaN) returns null and setPicked is skipped. On native the same code works because the responder system does populate locationX/Y. Mitigation: either use onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponderRelease on a plain View (which DO provide locationX on web), or Platform.select a <div onClick/> using offsetX/offsetY.
